sanskrit_verse: मृते तु स्वामिनि पुनस्तद्वंश्ये वापि मानवे । राजानमामन्त्र्य ततः प्रकुर्यात् सेतुकर्म तत् ॥
transliteration: mṛte tu svāmini punas tadvaṃśye vāpi mānave | rājānam āmantrya tataḥ prakuryāt setukarma tat ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the owner is deceased, or in his lineage a human capable of ownership exists, the King, having consulted, shall thereafter execute the duty of establishing order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious capacity, not inheritance alone
Causation arises from alignment with dharma, not bloodline
Restoration logic demands continuity of stewardship
executable_legal_axioms: IF owner_is_deceased AND lineage_has_capable_human THEN consult_king_for_succession
supreme_court_application: In matters of estate or governance succession where original authority has lapsed, the Supreme Court must verify that the proposed successor demonstrates conscious readiness and dharma alignment before ratifying any transfer of authority. Bloodline alone does not confer legitimacy; capacity and alignment do.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that rightful authority arises from inner alignment, not external inheritance. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of responsibility requires verification of consciousness-readiness. Punitive oversight is replaced by restorative validation ensuring continuity of dharmic function without coercion or judgment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Conduct consciousness assessment of potential successor
Verify alignment with existing dharmic structures
Initiate completion process for unresolved duties of predecessor
Reintegrate societal trust through transparent declaration of succession
Establish ongoing mentorship until full capacity is confirmed
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma flows through conscious capacity, succession serves restoration, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
